newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia hijacker frees 20 hostages - local official.
newsitem.headline: Russia hijacker frees 20 hostages - local official.

text.p: An armed hijacker released 20 of up to 32 hostages he had seized earlier on Monday in the southern Russian region of Dagestan, a spokeswoman for the regional interior ministry said.

"The hijacker first released two women and four children," she told Reuters by telephone. "He later freed another 14 people and by our count is still holding 12 hostages." She gave no further details.
Interfax news agency said that 20 released hostages had been swapped for a police officer whom it identified as Major Omar Tupaliyev. Interfax said 10 hostages remained in the bus.

An unidentified attacker armed with assault rifle seized a passenger bus near the Dagestani capital Makhachkala and demanded a helicopter. Itar-Tass news agency said he also demanded cash but this could no be confirmed.

Hijackings have not been uncommon in Russia's turbulent North Caucasus. Many have involved Chechens fighting for independence for their mainly Moslem region but others have been staged for ransom or unplanned responses to police searches.
